caption: The drawing depicts a loose-fitting, short-sleeved garment, likely a child’s tunic or dress, displayed flat with the front facing the viewer. The fabric is light beige or tan, rendered with a texture suggesting a woven material. The neckline is round and slightly open at the front, fastened by three small, light-colored buttons. Decorative embroidered patterns in green and pink run along the edges of the sleeves, neckline, down both sides of the front opening, and along the curved bottom hem. The embroidery features a combination of wavy and zig-zag lines with small leaf or vine-like motifs. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is centered on the page. In the bottom left corner, the name “Nancy Chan” is written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Boy's Coat
